title: Texture Trail
shareTitle: Texture Trail - A Clay Garden Sensory Adventure
description: Explore bumpy, smooth, ridged, and soft surfaces, then guide Pip the clay snail along four touch-friendly texture trails.
learningGoals: Recognize and name four surface textures
Connect tactile words with familiar real-world objects
Practice controlled tracing and extend learning into a real-room texture hunt
interactionModel: Choose a texture, explore two concrete examples, then tap or drag through eleven ordered clay stepping stones (seven on short landscape screens).
feedbackModel: Each correct contact earns a clay star, advances Pip, plays a soft pop, and adds optional haptics; a raster guide and gentle recorded hints identify the next step.
